violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Dishwasher used wet cloth to wipe down dirty side, clean side and top of dishwasher. -Wet cloth left at "clean" side of dish washer. -One sani bucket at cook line found with less than 100ppm Chlorine solution.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Visible food debris at blades of food chopper. -Peeling liner and food debris at interior lower doors of cold prep table at cookline.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical warewashing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration. -Dishwasher found with 0ppm Chlorine solution. Staff primed unit and ran 2 more times. *Service tech called while on-site and expected to arrive by ~3:30pm today.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc …) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Debris/residue at floors throughout kitchen and prep area. -Cloth towels on floor between fryer and oven (used as grease catch for frying chips). -Drain? odor at back prep area, visible debris at floor drain strainer.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 140F or above during display or service. -Deep half pan of rice on top of oven had temperature of 120F-152F. *Ensure ALL parts of hot holding foods are maintained at 140F or higher. Recommend storing rice pans in oven for better hot holding. *Low temp pan was stirred and returned to reheat.--Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. -Large bin of shredded cheese (on ice) at cookline had bottom temperature of 41 up to 50f at top of product. *Had staff reduce amount at cook line and to move top portion into walk in cooler. -3 cups of queso left out of temperature at shelf above prep table and in microwave with temps of 57-94F. *Staging a few items for short periods during busy service is ok, however, product should be kept under refrigeration at 41F or less whenever possible.

General employee practices. — --Employee failed to maintain a high degree of personal cleanliness or observe proper hygienic practices. > Observed employee handling clean dishes and dirty dishes without handwashing. Observed employee cough into hands and continue to handle clean dishes without handwashing.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Different species of raw animal food * was not properly separated from each other or arranged according to minimum cooking temperatures. > Observed raw chicken next to open container of raw fish in prep station cooler. Corrected with employee.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. > Storage table was not in good repair in the back of the kitchen. Visibly peeling and pulling apart underneath. > Lid covering the chip container visibly cracked. > Cold hold prep table has liner on the inside door that needs peeled off.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. > Vegetable chopper in the kitchen was being held in cleaned dishes area while visibly was dirty. > Cutting board being stored was in need of washing.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. > The sinks floor drain in the prep area of the kitchen is currently using a strainer to cover the drain and catch food items. Repair the drain.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. > The walls in the prep area of the kitchen are in need of some cleaning. Visible splatter on walls. Visible splatter on the mini split HVAC unit.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. > Floor towards the back door is missing floor tiling that creates a gap for insects to enter the building.
